user_input: According to AA23-061A, which ATT&CK technique is connected to Royal actors through the reported use of Chisel? Explain the two-hop actor-to-software-to-technique path with evidence.
response:
Royal actors use Chisel to connect to Protocol Tunneling (T1572). [E1, E2, E3]
Filter Network Traffic (M1037) mitigates Protocol Tunneling (T1572) by filtering network traffic to untrusted or known bad domains and resources. [E4, E5]
Network Intrusion Prevention (M1031) mitigates Protocol Tunneling (T1572) by using network signatures to identify traffic for specific adversary malware. [E6, E7]

reference: AA23-061A reports that Royal actors were historically observed using Chisel to communicate with their C2 infrastructure. The advisory associates this tool use with T1572 (Protocol Tunneling). The two links are Royal actors → USES → Chisel → USES_TECHNIQUE → T1572; this preserves the historical observation rather than asserting current use.
